title: ci(test-core): a shard whose tests read no .d.ts builds its closure with OS_SKIP_DTS=1
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DTotpiGYVS8HCVm8u3FZDUX)_
Fixes #25375
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**：Test Core 六个分片在建依赖闭包前多一步「Choose this shard's declaration build」。分片里没有 `@objectstack/cli`、`@objectstack/metadata` 时，整个分片设 `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`，构建只出 JavaScript，不再生成 `.d.ts`（spec 那次 6 GB 堆的声明构建、cli 的完整 `tsc` 都省掉）。带这两个包的分片照旧。只改 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`。

**为什么改**：vitest 只加载 JS，大多数分片生成的声明文件没人读。本地 4 核冷构建同一闭包（65 个包）：开声明 5m59s，关声明 1m24s。卡面原方案是六个分片全关，但实测全关会让 cli（4 个测试文件，24 例）和 metadata（1 个文件）红，原因都是 TS7016 找不到 spec / cli 的 `.d.ts`，这些测试本来就是在编译已发布的声明。所以这两个包所在的分片保留声明。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**：① 关声明的分片和 Build Core 不在同一个 turbo 哈希空间（`turbo.json` 的 `globalEnv`），读不到 Build Core 写进远端缓存的带声明产物，只能读本分片在合并队列和 main 上写的无声明产物；落地后头几轮会偏冷，之后自愈。② 以后若有新测试读已建好的 `.d.ts` 却落在关声明的分片，会以 TS7016 明确变红，修法是把它的包加进 `DTS_READERS`，不会静默放过。③ 全量跑时 cli 切 3 片、metadata 占 1 片，当前切法下只有分片 1、6 省；PR 只跑受影响包时省的分片更多。回滚：删掉这一步即可。

**席位意见**：同意落地（devx 席位已在 head e62c37b 复核，ACCEPT 见 #25375）。机制早已在 main 上（`turbo.json` 的 `globalEnv` 和各包 tsup 配置），本 PR 只决定哪些分片打开它。收窄到不含 cli、metadata 的分片是对的；漏掉的读者会以 TS7016 明确变红，不会静默放过。落地后头几轮偏冷属预期。

**你要做的**：以 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 账户审批本 PR（受管面 Tier H）。

## What changed

One new step in the `test` job, right after "Compute this shard's package set":
it writes `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` to `$GITHUB_ENV` unless the shard's package list
carries a package in `DTS_READERS` (`@objectstack/cli @objectstack/metadata`).
Through `$GITHUB_ENV` it reaches both closure builds, the test step and the
main-push seed, so all of them hash in one namespace (`turbo.json` `globalEnv`).
`turbo.json` is untouched.

## The card's step 2: tests that read a `.d.ts`

The card's premise "vitest never reads a `.d.ts`" is false for two packages.
The static grep the card names gives 70 test files that mention `.d.ts`, so I
measured instead. Under `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`, the whole Test Core list (dogfood
excluded, `OS_TEST_TIERS=queue`) ran on 830a63a in a cloud container. These
went red:

| Package | Test file | Reads | Disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `@objectstack/cli` | `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` (6 tests) | cli's own `dist/console.d.ts` | shard keeps DTS |
| `@objectstack/cli` | `test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts` (4) | cli's own `dist/hook-body.d.ts` | shard keeps DTS |
| `@objectstack/cli` | `test/scaffold-emission-typechecks.test.ts` (12) | spec's `dist/**/*.d.ts` (TS7016) | shard keeps DTS |
| `@objectstack/cli` | `test/scaffold-test-script-passes.test.ts` (2) | spec's `dist/**/*.d.ts` (TS7016) | shard keeps DTS |
| `@objectstack/metadata` | `src/serializers/typescript-serializer-annotation.test.ts` (1) | spec's `dist/**/*.d.ts` (TS7016) | shard keeps DTS |

`@objectstack/example-showcase` was killed (exit 137) in that run because the
local container ran out of memory. Run alone under `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` it passed:
37 files, 443 tests.

Silent-skip check: 32 packages own a test that compiles a TS program or names a
`.d.ts`. I ran them again with declarations on and compared the vitest totals
per task. All 38 `test`/`test:repo` totals were identical except one.
`@objectstack/spec:test` ran 21634 passed with DTS and 21632 passed plus 1
skipped without it. The difference is
`scripts/root-entry-type-nameability.pin.test.ts`, which skips by its own design
when spec's dist declarations are absent. That pin runs with
`OS_EXPECT_ROOT_NAMEABILITY=1` against a built dist in lint.yml's
`root-entry-type-nameability-pin-built-dist` step, so its coverage holds.

## Measurement

Local, cloud container, 4 cores, the same 65-package closure (every package
whose `build` the full Test Core list schedules), `turbo run build --force
--concurrency=4`:

| | Wall | Σ task time | `@objectstack/spec#build` | `@objectstack/cli#build` |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| declarations on | 5m59s | 838s | 92.2s | 18.5s |
| `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` | 1m24s | 146s | 47.8s | 7.6s |

That is 23% of the DTS-on wall time, against the card's ceiling of 60%.

Today's baseline on CI, from the card: cold closure step 3.1 to 6.0 min per
shard on PR run 39891259937, about 31 runner-minutes in total.

On main after the shard-timings refresh (#25409), the full list puts metadata
on shard 2 and the three cli slices on shards 3 to 5, so shards 1 and 6 skip
on a full run. On a PR the affected set decides. This PR's own diff selects
only `@objectstack/driver-sql` (a declared ci.yml input), so its first run
measures a cold DTS-off closure. Nothing in the remote cache has DTS-off
hashes yet. The CI step timings from this PR, both ways, are posted as a PR
comment.

Replay trade-off: a skipping shard cannot replay Build Core's DTS-on remote
artifacts. In steady state that costs nothing. Every package hash a merge
introduces is built in the queue run's shard closures, which write the remote
(`remote:rw` on `merge_group` and main pushes). That gives later PRs a DTS-off
hit for every package they do not change. The packages a PR does change miss
both ways, and they build faster without declarations. The cost is real only
in the first runs after landing.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` lists 54 commands. All 54 exit 0
on 8d58beb3. `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` were re-run
after a full DTS-on `pnpm build`, because they read a built tree. `actionlint`
is not installed here. The workflow parses as YAML, and the job's step order
is unchanged around the new step.

## Acceptance notes

- Scope deviation from the card's step 1: two packages' shards keep their
  declarations, for the reason above. The other way to save on those shards is
  to keep only spec's and cli's declarations under a per-package variable.
  That needs `tsup.config.*`, cli's `build` script and `turbo.json`
  `globalEnv`, which is outside this card's file surface, so it is not done
  here.
- `.github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml` builds its own shard closure and
  is not changed here.
